e|ada benarnya juga.text: Mungkin ada benarnya juga kalau kita istirahat sebentar dulu.
e|ada benarnya juga.en: Maybe it's true that we should take a short break first.
e|ada benarnya juga.ko: 아마 우리가 잠깐 쉬는 게 맞을 수도 있어.

e|ada benarnya juga.text: Kata temanmu, harga di sana lebih murah, ada benarnya juga sih.
e|ada benarnya juga.en: Your friend said the prices there are cheaper, and that's probably true.
e|ada benarnya juga.ko: 네 친구가 거기 물가가 더 싸다고 했는데, 맞는 말이야.

e|ada benarnya juga.text: Menurutmu kita harus berhati-hati, ada benarnya juga karena cuaca sedang buruk.
e|ada benarnya juga.en: You think we should be careful, and that's true because the weather is bad.
e|ada benarnya juga.ko: 네가 조심해야 한다고 했는데, 맞는 말이야. 날씨가 안 좋으니까.

e|ada masalah.text: Maaf, ada masalah dengan internet hari ini.
e|ada masalah.en: Sorry, there is a problem with the internet today.

e|ada masalah.text: Kalau ada masalah, kamu bisa cerita ke saya.
e|ada masalah.en: If there is a problem, you can talk to me.

e|ada masalah.text: Saya dengar ada masalah di kantor kemarin.
e|ada masalah.en: I heard there was a problem at the office yesterday.

e|ada udang di balik batu.text: Tiba-tiba dia jadi baik banget, aku curiga ada udang di balik batu.
e|ada udang di balik batu.en: Suddenly he's being really nice, I suspect there's something hidden behind it.
e|ada udang di balik batu.ko: 갑자기 그가 너무 친절해졌어, 뭔가 숨겨진 속셈이 있는 것 같아.

e|ada udang di balik batu.text: Kenapa dia menawar harga semurah itu, jangan-jangan ada udang di balik batu?
e|ada udang di balik batu.en: Why is he offering such a low price, could there be something fishy going on?
e|ada udang di balik batu.ko: 왜 그는 그렇게 싸게 값을 제시하지? 뭔가 수상한 게 있는 건 아닐까?

e|ada udang di balik batu.text: Kalau penawarannya terlalu bagus, biasanya ada udang di balik batu.
e|ada udang di balik batu.en: If the offer is too good, usually there’s something fishy behind it.
e|ada udang di balik batu.ko: 만약 제안이 너무 좋다면, 보통 뭔가 수상한 게 있는 거야.

e|apa boleh buat.text: Kopi tumpah di meja, apa boleh buat, sudah kejadian.
e|apa boleh buat.en: The coffee spilled on the table, what can we do, it already happened.
e|apa boleh buat.ko: 커피가 테이블에 쏟아졌어, 어쩔 수 없지, 이미 일어난 일이야.

e|apa boleh buat.text: Tiket konsernya habis, apa boleh buat, kita cari hiburan lain saja.
e|apa boleh buat.en: The concert tickets are sold out, what can we do, let's just find another entertainment.
e|apa boleh buat.ko: 콘서트 티켓이 다 팔렸어, 어쩔 수 없지, 그냥 다른 즐길 거리를 찾자.

e|apa boleh buat.text: Hujan deras saat mau pergi, apa boleh buat, kita tunggu reda dulu.
e|apa boleh buat.en: It's raining heavily when we want to go, what can we do, let's wait until it stops.
e|apa boleh buat.ko: 나가려는데 비가 많이 와, 어쩔 수 없지, 비가 그칠 때까지 기다리자.

e|apa kabar.en: Long time no see, how are you?

e|atas nama tim.text: Atas nama tim, saya ingin mengucapkan terima kasih atas dukungan Anda selama ini.
e|atas nama tim.en: On behalf of the team, I want to thank you for your support all this time.
e|atas nama tim.ko: 팀을 대표해서, 지금까지의 지원에 감사드린다는 말씀을 드리고 싶습니다.

e|atas nama tim.text: Atas nama tim, kami mohon maaf atas keterlambatan pengiriman barang.
e|atas nama tim.en: On behalf of the team, we apologize for the delay in shipping the goods.
e|atas nama tim.ko: 팀을 대표해서, 상품 배송 지연에 대해 사과드립니다.

e|atas nama tim.text: Atas nama tim, saya ingin menyampaikan selamat atas pencapaian Anda.
e|atas nama tim.en: On behalf of the team, I want to congratulate you on your achievement.

e|bagaimana kalau.text: Bagaimana kalau kamu yang presentasi duluan?
Bagaimana kalau kita tunda rapatnya sampai besok?
e|bagaimana kalau.en: How about we postpone the meeting until tomorrow?

e|bagaimana kalau.text: Bagaimana kalau kita makan siang di luar hari ini?
e|bagaimana kalau.en: How about we have lunch outside today?
e|bagaimana kalau.ko: 오늘 점심을 밖에서 먹는 건 어때?

e|basa-basi.text: Aku capek harus basa-basi setiap kali ketemu orang baru.
e|basa-basi.en: I'm tired of having to make small talk every time I meet new people.
e|basa-basi.ko: 새로운 사람을 만날 때마다 형식적인 인사를 해야 해서 피곤해.

e|basa-basi.text: Kalau ngobrol sama dia, nggak perlu basa-basi, langsung aja ke intinya.
e|basa-basi.en: When talking to him, you don't need small talk, just get straight to the point.
e|basa-basi.ko: 그 사람과 얘기할 때는 형식적인 말 필요 없이 바로 본론으로 들어가.

e|basa-basi.text: Sering kali basa-basi itu justru bikin suasana jadi canggung.
e|basa-basi.en: Often, small talk actually makes things awkward.
e|basa-basi.ko: 형식적인 대화가 오히려 분위기를 어색하게 만들 때가 많아.

e|berapa harganya.text: Permisi, berapa harganya untuk satu apel?
e|berapa harganya.en: Excuse me, how much is it for one apple?

e|berapa harganya.text: Saya ingin tahu berapa harganya tas itu.
e|berapa harganya.en: I want to know how much is it for that bag.
Sorry, how much is it for this drink?

e|besok.en: We go to the market tomorrow.

e|bikin baper.text: Aduh, lagu itu benar-benar bikin baper, deh.
e|bikin baper.en: Oh, that song really makes me emotional.
e|bikin baper.ko: 오, 그 노래 정말 감정적으로 만들어요.

e|bikin baper.text: Jangan ngomong kayak gitu, nanti aku malah makin bikin baper.
e|bikin baper.en: Don't say things like that, you'll just make me even more emotional.
e|bikin baper.ko: 그렇게 말하지 마, 나 더 감정적으로 만들 거야.

e|bikin baper.text: Nonton film romantis sendirian suka bikin baper nggak sih?
e|bikin baper.en: Does watching romantic movies alone ever make you emotional?
e|bikin baper.ko: 로맨틱 영화를 혼자 보면 감정적으로 되지 않아?

e|bisa dibantu.en: Sorry, is there anything I can help with?

e|bisa dibantu.text: Kalau ada masalah, saya bisa dibantu.
e|bisa dibantu.en: If there is a problem, I can help.
e|bisa dibantu.ko: 문제가 있으면, 제가 도와드릴 수 있어요.

e|bisa dibantu.text: Silakan tanya jika butuh bisa dibantu.
e|bisa dibantu.en: Please ask if you need any help.

e|boleh.text: Maaf, boleh saya duduk di sini?

e|bungkus.en: Do you want to wrap this food?

e|bungkus.text: Saya beli bungkus roti di toko itu.
e|bungkus.en: I bought a pack of bread at that shop.
e|bungkus.ko: 그 가게에서 빵 한 봉지를 샀어요.

e|capek banget.text: Hari ini aku capek banget setelah kerja.
e|capek banget.en: Today I'm really tired after work.

e|capek banget.text: Aku capek banget, mau istirahat dulu ya.
e|capek banget.en: I'm really tired, I want to rest for a bit.
e|capek banget.ko: 나 정말 피곤해, 좀 쉬고 싶어.

e|capek banget.text: Baru pulang dari pasar, capek banget deh.
e|capek banget.en: Just got back from the market, I'm really tired.

e|dengan kata lain.text: Dia selalu datang telat, dengan kata lain, dia kurang disiplin.
e|dengan kata lain.en: He always comes late, in other words, he is not very disciplined.
e|dengan kata lain.ko: 그는 항상 늦게 오는데, 다시 말해 그는 별로 규칙적이지 않아.

e|dengan kata lain.text: Aku nggak suka makanan pedas, dengan kata lain, aku pasti pilih yang tidak pedas.
e|dengan kata lain.en: I don't like spicy food, in other words, I'll definitely choose something not spicy.
e|dengan kata lain.ko: 나는 매운 음식을 좋아하지 않아, 다시 말해 나는 매운 거 안 고를 거야.

e|dengan kata lain.text: Kamu belum mengerjakan tugas, dengan kata lain, kamu harus lembur malam ini.
e|dengan kata lain.en: You haven't done your assignment, in other words, you have to work late tonight.
e|dengan kata lain.ko: 너는 아직 과제를 안 했으니까, 다시 말해 오늘 밤 늦게까지 해야 해.

e|dengan segala hormat.text: Dengan segala hormat, saya ingin mengajukan beberapa pertanyaan tentang proyek ini.
e|dengan segala hormat.en: With all due respect, I would like to ask a few questions about this project.
e|dengan segala hormat.ko: 진심으로 존경을 표하며, 이 프로젝트에 대해 몇 가지 질문을 하고 싶습니다.

e|dengan segala hormat.text: Maaf, dengan segala hormat, saya kurang setuju dengan pendapat Anda.
e|dengan segala hormat.en: Sorry, with all due respect, I disagree with your opinion.
e|dengan segala hormat.ko: 죄송하지만, 진심으로 존경을 표하며 저는 당신의 의견에 동의하지 않습니다.

e|dengan segala hormat.text: Dengan segala hormat, apakah Anda bisa menjelaskan alasan perubahan jadwal?
e|dengan segala hormat.en: With all due respect, could you explain the reason for the schedule change?
e|dengan segala hormat.ko: 진심으로 존경을 표하며, 일정 변경의 이유를 설명해 주실 수 있나요?

e|di satu sisi.text: Di satu sisi, aku senang bisa bekerja dari rumah, tapi di sisi lain, aku jadi jarang ketemu teman-teman.
e|di satu sisi.en: On one hand, I'm happy to work from home, but on the other hand, I rarely meet my friends.
e|di satu sisi.ko: 한편으로는 집에서 일할 수 있어서 좋지만, 다른 한편으로는 친구들을 거의 못 만나게 돼.

e|di satu sisi.text: Di satu sisi, hujan membuat udara sejuk, tapi di sisi lain, jadi sulit pergi ke mana-mana.
e|di satu sisi.en: On one hand, the rain makes the air cool, but on the other hand, it's hard to go anywhere.
e|di satu sisi.ko: 한편으로는 비가 와서 공기가 시원하지만, 다른 한편으로는 어디 가기 힘들어.

e|di satu sisi.text: Di satu sisi, belajar online itu praktis, tapi kadang aku merasa kurang fokus.
e|di satu sisi.en: On one hand, studying online is practical, but sometimes I feel less focused.
e|di satu sisi.ko: 한편으로는 온라인으로 공부하는 것이 편리하지만, 가끔 집중이 덜 되는 것 같아.

e|di sisi lain.text: Aku suka tinggal di kota, tapi di sisi lain, aku juga rindu suasana desa.
e|di sisi lain.en: I like living in the city, but on the other hand, I also miss the village atmosphere.
e|di sisi lain.ko: 나는 도시에 사는 것이 좋지만, 한편으로는 시골 분위기도 그리워.

e|di sisi lain.text: Kerja dari rumah memang nyaman, di sisi lain kadang terasa sepi juga.
e|di sisi lain.en: Working from home is comfortable, but on the other hand, it sometimes feels lonely too.
e|di sisi lain.ko: 재택근무는 편하지만, 한편으론 때때로 외롭기도 해.

e|di sisi lain.text: Makanan pedas enak sekali, di sisi lain perutku sering bermasalah setelah makan.
e|di sisi lain.en: Spicy food is really delicious, but on the other hand, my stomach often has problems after eating it.
e|di sisi lain.ko: 매운 음식은 정말 맛있지만, 한편으로 먹고 나면 속이 자주 안 좋아져.

e|emang sih.text: Emang sih hujan deras, tapi aku tetap mau pergi ke toko.
e|emang sih.en: It is true that it's raining heavily, but I still want to go to the store.
e|emang sih.ko: 비가 많이 오긴 하지만, 그래도 나는 가게에 가고 싶어.

e|emang sih.text: Emang sih makanannya pedas, tapi rasanya enak banget.
e|emang sih.en: It's true the food is spicy, but it tastes really good.

e|emang sih.text: Emang sih tugasnya banyak, tapi kalau dicicil pasti selesai kok.
e|emang sih.en: It's true there are a lot of assignments, but if you do them little by little, you'll finish for sure.
e|emang sih.ko: 과제가 많긴 하지만, 조금씩 하면 분명히 끝날 거야.

e|gimana ya.text: Gimana ya, aku lupa taruh kunci mobil.
e|gimana ya.en: Hmm, I forgot where I put the car keys.
e|gimana ya.ko: 음, 나 자동차 열쇠 어디에 뒀는지 잊어버렸어.

e|gimana ya.text: Gimana ya cara bikin kopi enak?
e|gimana ya.en: How do you make good coffee?

e|gimana ya.text: Gimana ya kalau kita nonton film malam ini?
e|gimana ya.en: How about we watch a movie tonight?

e|gitu deh.text: Aku udah coba jelasin, tapi dia nggak ngerti juga, gitu deh.
e|gitu deh.en: I already tried to explain, but he still doesn't get it, that's just how it is.
e|gitu deh.ko: 내가 이미 설명하려고 했는데, 그는 여전히 이해하지 못해, 그냥 그런 거야.

e|gitu deh.text: Kalau kamu nggak suka makanannya, ya bilang aja, gitu deh.
e|gitu deh.en: If you don't like the food, just say it, that's it.
e|gitu deh.ko: 음식이 마음에 안 들면 그냥 말해, 그뿐이야.

e|gitu deh.text: Aku nggak tahu kenapa dia tiba-tiba marah, gitu deh.
e|gitu deh.en: I don't know why she suddenly got angry, that's just how it is.
e|gitu deh.ko: 그녀가 갑자기 왜 화냈는지 잘 모르겠어, 그냥 그런 거야.

e|harganya bisa kurang.text: Maaf, harganya bisa kurang kalau saya beli dua?
e|harganya bisa kurang.en: Excuse me, can the price be reduced if I buy two?
e|harganya bisa kurang.ko: 실례합니다, 두 개 사면 가격을 깎을 수 있나요?

e|harganya bisa kurang.text: Saya suka barang ini, tapi harganya bisa kurang?
e|harganya bisa kurang.en: I like this item, but can the price be lowered?
e|harganya bisa kurang.ko: 이 물건이 마음에 드는데, 가격을 깎을 수 있나요?

e|harganya bisa kurang.text: Kalau saya bayar tunai, harganya bisa kurang?
e|harganya bisa kurang.en: If I pay in cash, can the price be reduced?
e|harganya bisa kurang.ko: 현금으로 내면 가격을 깎을 수 있나요?

e|hati-hati.en: The road is slippery, be careful.
Be careful when crossing the street.

e|intinya.text: Intinya, kita harus saling percaya kalau mau kerjasama.
e|intinya.en: The point is, we have to trust each other if we want to work together.
e|intinya.ko: 요점은 우리가 함께 일하려면 서로를 믿어야 한다는 거야.

e|intinya.text: Aku tahu kamu sibuk, tapi intinya aku butuh jawaban hari ini.
e|intinya.en: I know you're busy, but the point is I need an answer today.
e|intinya.ko: 네가 바쁜 거 알지만, 요점은 내가 오늘 답이 필요하다는 거야.

e|intinya.text: Intinya, jangan lupa bawa payung karena cuaca nggak menentu.
e|intinya.en: The point is, don't forget to bring an umbrella because the weather is unpredictable.
e|intinya.ko: 요점은, 날씨가 변덕스러우니까 우산을 꼭 챙기라는 거야.

e|izinkan saya.text: Maaf, izinkan saya mengambil buku itu sebentar.
e|izinkan saya.en: Sorry, allow me to take that book for a moment.
e|izinkan saya.ko: 미안하지만, 제가 그 책을 잠깐 가져가도 될까요?

e|izinkan saya.text: Izinkan saya menjelaskan dulu sebelum kamu bertanya.
e|izinkan saya.en: Allow me to explain first before you ask.

e|izinkan saya.text: Izinkan saya membantu membawakan belanjaanmu ke dalam.
e|izinkan saya.en: Allow me to help carry your groceries inside.
e|izinkan saya.ko: 제가 당신의 장을 안으로 옮기는 걸 도와드릴게요.

e|jam berapa.en: Excuse me, what time is it now?

e|jam berapa.text: Kamu tahu jam berapa toko buka?
e|jam berapa.en: Do you know what time the store opens?

e|jam berapa.text: Saya lupa jam berapa film dimulai.
e|jam berapa.en: I forgot what time the movie starts.

e|jangan salah paham.text: Jangan salah paham, aku tidak bermaksud menyinggung siapa pun.
e|jangan salah paham.en: Don't get me wrong, I didn't mean to offend anyone.
e|jangan salah paham.ko: 오해하지 마, 누구를 불쾌하게 할 의도는 아니었어.

e|jangan salah paham.text: Kalau aku bicara cepat, jangan salah paham ya, aku cuma gugup.
e|jangan salah paham.en: If I speak fast, don't get me wrong, I'm just nervous.
e|jangan salah paham.ko: 내가 말을 빨리 해도 오해하지 마, 그냥 긴장해서 그래.

e|jangan salah paham.text: Jangan salah paham, aku benar-benar ingin membantu kamu.
e|jangan salah paham.en: Don't get me wrong, I really want to help you.
e|jangan salah paham.ko: 오해하지 마, 나는 정말로 널 도와주고 싶어.

e|jujur aja.text: Jujur aja, aku belum siap untuk ujian besok.
e|jujur aja.en: Honestly, I'm not ready for the exam tomorrow.
e|jujur aja.ko: 솔직히 말해서, 나 내일 시험 준비 안 됐어.

e|jujur aja.text: Jujur aja, aku nggak terlalu suka makanan pedas.
e|jujur aja.en: Honestly, I don't really like spicy food.
e|jujur aja.ko: 솔직히, 나는 매운 음식 별로 안 좋아해.

e|jujur aja.text: Jujur aja, tadi aku lupa bawa dompet.
e|jujur aja.en: Honestly, I forgot to bring my wallet earlier.
e|jujur aja.ko: 솔직히, 나 아까 지갑 가져오는 거 깜빡했어.

e|kabar baik.text: Dia bilang kabar baik saat ditanya.
e|kabar baik.en: She said she is fine when asked.
e|kabar baik.ko: 누군가 물었을 때 그녀는 잘 지낸다고 했어요.

e|kabar baik.text: Semua keluarga kabar baik di rumah.
e|kabar baik.en: All the family are fine at home.
e|kabar baik.ko: 집에 있는 가족 모두 잘 지내요.

e|kalau boleh usul.text: Kalau boleh usul, bagaimana kalau kita pindah ke tempat yang lebih tenang?
e|kalau boleh usul.en: If I may suggest, how about we move to a quieter place?
e|kalau boleh usul.ko: 혹시 제안해도 된다면, 더 조용한 곳으로 옮기는 게 어때요?

e|kalau boleh usul.text: Kalau boleh usul, mungkin sebaiknya kita mulai rapat sedikit lebih awal besok.
e|kalau boleh usul.en: If I may suggest, maybe we should start the meeting a bit earlier tomorrow.
e|kalau boleh usul.ko: 혹시 제안해도 된다면, 내일 회의를 조금 더 일찍 시작하는 게 좋을 것 같아요.

e|kalau boleh usul.text: Kalau boleh usul, coba tambahkan sedikit garam ke masakan ini.
e|kalau boleh usul.en: If I may suggest, try adding a bit of salt to this dish.
e|kalau boleh usul.ko: 혹시 제안해도 된다면, 이 요리에 소금을 조금 넣어보세요.

e|kayaknya.en: It looks like it’s going to rain.
I think I forgot to bring my wallet.

e|kayaknya.text: Kayaknya dia lagi sibuk hari ini.
e|kayaknya.en: It seems like he is busy today.
e|kayaknya.ko: 그 사람 오늘 바쁜 것 같아.

e|ketemu di mana.text: Kamu ketemu di mana teman baru itu?
e|ketemu di mana.en: Where did you meet that new friend?
e|ketemu di mana.ko: 너 그 새 친구 어디에서 만났어?

e|ketemu di mana.text: Saya lupa, kita ketemu di mana ya?
e|ketemu di mana.en: I forgot, where did we meet?

e|kiri di sini.text: Saya turun di kiri di sini.
e|kiri di sini.en: I get off on the left here.

e|kiri di sini.text: Tolong berhenti di kiri di sini.
e|kiri di sini.en: Please stop on the left here.

e|kiri di sini.text: Apakah jalan keluar di kiri di sini?
e|kiri di sini.en: Is the exit on the left here?

e|kita sepakat.text: Jadi, kita sepakat untuk bertemu lagi minggu depan ya.
e|kita sepakat.en: So, we agree to meet again next week, right?
e|kita sepakat.ko: 그러니까 우리 다음 주에 다시 만나기로 한 거지?

e|kita sepakat.text: Kalau kita sepakat, besok aku akan mulai pekerjaannya.
e|kita sepakat.en: If we agree, I will start the work tomorrow.
e|kita sepakat.ko: 우리가 동의하면 내일 내가 일을 시작할게.

e|kita sepakat.text: Bagus, berarti kita sepakat soal harga ini.
e|kita sepakat.en: Great, that means we agree about this price.
e|kita sepakat.ko: 좋아, 그럼 이 가격에 동의하는 거네.

e|kok bisa.text: Loh, kok bisa lampunya tiba-tiba mati ya?
e|kok bisa.en: Huh, how could the light suddenly go out?

e|kok bisa.text: Kamu kok bisa hafal semua lagu itu?
e|kok bisa.en: How come you can memorize all those songs?
e|kok bisa.ko: 너는 어떻게 그 모든 노래를 외울 수 있지?

e|kok bisa.text: Kok bisa lupa bawa dompet sih?
e|kok bisa.en: How could you forget to bring your wallet?

e|kurang setuju.text: Maaf, saya kurang setuju dengan pendapatmu.
e|kurang setuju.en: Sorry, I don't really agree with your opinion.
e|kurang setuju.ko: 미안하지만, 나는 네 의견에 별로 동의하지 않아.

e|kurang setuju.text: Aku kurang setuju kalau itu cara terbaik.
e|kurang setuju.en: I don't really agree that it's the best way.
e|kurang setuju.ko: 나는 그게 최고의 방법이라고 별로 생각하지 않아.

e|kurang setuju.text: Saya kurang setuju jika harus pergi sekarang.
e|kurang setuju.en: I don't really agree if we have to go now.
e|kurang setuju.ko: 지금 가야 한다면 나는 별로 동의하지 않아.

e|lagi apa.en: Hi, what are you doing now?
What are you doing at home?
What are you doing this afternoon?

e|lain kali aja.text: Mau ikut nonton film? Lain kali aja, aku lagi capek hari ini.
e|lain kali aja.en: Want to come watch a movie? Maybe next time, I'm tired today.
e|lain kali aja.ko: 영화 보러 갈래? 다음에 하자, 오늘은 피곤해.

e|lain kali aja.text: Terima kasih sudah mengundang, tapi lain kali aja ya, soalnya aku ada janji.
e|lain kali aja.en: Thank you for inviting me, but maybe next time, because I have an appointment.
e|lain kali aja.ko: 초대해줘서 고마워, 그런데 다음에 하자, 약속이 있어.

e|lain kali aja.text: Kalau mau ngobrol lebih lama, lain kali aja deh, sekarang aku harus pergi.
e|lain kali aja.en: If you want to chat longer, maybe next time, I have to go now.
e|lain kali aja.ko: 더 오래 이야기하고 싶으면, 다음에 하자, 지금은 가야 해.

e|lebih baik.en: It's better if we leave now.

e|lebih baik.text: Menurut saya, lebih baik kamu istirahat dulu.
e|lebih baik.en: In my opinion, it's better for you to rest first.
e|lebih baik.ko: 내 생각엔, 네가 먼저 쉬는 게 더 좋아.

e|lebih baik.text: Kalau hujan, lebih baik tunggu di dalam.
e|lebih baik.en: If it rains, it's better to wait inside.
e|lebih baik.ko: 비가 오면, 안에서 기다리는 게 더 좋아.

e|lumayan.en: The weather today is quite cool.
I have quite a lot of work this week.

e|lurus terus.text: Jalan saja lurus terus sampai lampu merah.
e|lurus terus.en: Just go straight until the traffic light.

e|lurus terus.text: Kalau mau ke pasar, lurus terus dari sini.
e|lurus terus.en: If you want to go to the market, go straight from here.
e|lurus terus.ko: 시장에 가고 싶으면 여기서 계속 곧장 가세요.

e|lurus terus.text: Untuk ke kantor pos, lurus terus lalu belok kiri.
e|lurus terus.en: To get to the post office, go straight then turn left.
e|lurus terus.ko: 우체국에 가려면 계속 곧장 가다가 왼쪽으로 도세요.

e|makan di sini.text: Apakah Anda ingin makan di sini?
e|makan di sini.en: Do you want to eat here?

e|makan di sini.text: Tolong siapkan meja untuk makan di sini.
e|makan di sini.en: Please prepare a table to eat here.
e|makan di sini.ko: 여기서 먹을 수 있게 테이블을 준비해 주세요.

e|masa sih.text: Masa sih kamu belum makan dari pagi?
e|masa sih.en: Really, you haven't eaten since morning?

e|masa sih.text: Masa sih hujan lagi hari ini?

e|masuk angin.text: Saya merasa masuk angin hari ini.
e|masuk angin.en: I feel unwell today (like I caught a chill).

e|masuk angin.text: Jangan mandi malam, nanti masuk angin.
e|masuk angin.en: Don't shower at night, you might catch a chill.
e|masuk angin.ko: 밤에 샤워하지 마, 감기 들 수 있어.

e|masuk angin.text: Sudah minum obat untuk masuk angin?
e|masuk angin.en: Have you taken medicine for feeling unwell?

e|mau tidak mau.text: Mau tidak mau, kita harus menyelesaikan tugas ini hari ini.
e|mau tidak mau.en: Like it or not, we have to finish this task today.
e|mau tidak mau.ko: 좋든 싫든 오늘 이 일을 끝내야 해.

e|mau tidak mau.text: Dia harus menerima keputusan itu, mau tidak mau.
e|mau tidak mau.en: He has to accept that decision, like it or not.
e|mau tidak mau.ko: 그는 그 결정을 좋든 싫든 받아들여야 해.

e|mau tidak mau.text: Kalau sudah terlambat, mau tidak mau kita harus menunggu giliran berikutnya.
e|mau tidak mau.en: If we're already late, like it or not we have to wait for the next turn.
e|mau tidak mau.ko: 이미 늦었으면, 좋든 싫든 다음 차례를 기다려야 해.

e|mending.text: Mending kita nonton film di rumah aja malam ini.
e|mending.en: We'd better just watch a movie at home tonight.
e|mending.ko: 오늘 밤은 그냥 집에서 영화 보는 게 낫겠어.

e|mending.text: Kalau hujan terus begini, mending tunda dulu perjalanannya.
e|mending.en: If it keeps raining like this, it's better to postpone the trip.
e|mending.ko: 비가 계속 이렇게 오면 여행을 미루는 게 낫겠어.

e|mending.text: Mending kamu bilang yang sebenarnya dari awal.
e|mending.en: You should have just told the truth from the start.
e|mending.ko: 처음부터 진실을 말하는 게 나았을 거야.

e|menurut saya.text: Menurut saya, cuaca hari ini cukup cerah.
e|menurut saya.en: I think the weather is quite sunny today.
e|menurut saya.ko: 내 생각에 오늘 날씨가 꽤 맑아.

e|menurut saya.text: Menurut saya, makanan ini terlalu pedas.
e|menurut saya.en: I think this food is too spicy.
e|menurut saya.ko: 내 생각에 이 음식은 너무 매워.

e|menurut saya.text: Menurut saya, film itu sangat menarik.
e|menurut saya.en: I think that movie is very interesting.
e|menurut saya.ko: 내 생각에 그 영화는 아주 재미있어.

e|minta tolong.en: Can you please get me some water?
I need help opening the door.

e|minta tolong.text: Maaf, boleh minta tolong fotokan saya?
e|minta tolong.en: Excuse me, can you please take a photo of me?
e|minta tolong.ko: 죄송한데, 사진 좀 찍어줄 수 있어요?

e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.text: Mohon maaf sebelumnya, saya baru bisa membalas pesan kamu sekarang.
e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.en: Sorry in advance, I could only reply to your message now.
e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.ko: 미리 사과드려요, 이제야 당신의 메시지에 답장할 수 있었어요.

e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.text: Mohon maaf sebelumnya, apakah kursi ini sudah ada yang duduki?
e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.en: Sorry in advance, is this seat already taken?
e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.ko: 미리 사과드리는데, 이 자리에 이미 누가 앉아 있나요?

e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.text: Mohon maaf sebelumnya, saya tidak sengaja menghapus file kamu.
e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.en: Sorry in advance, I accidentally deleted your file.
e|mohon maaf sebelumnya.ko: 미리 사과드리는데, 실수로 당신의 파일을 삭제했어요.

e|nggak enak hati.text: Aku nggak enak hati nggak bisa datang ke acara kamu besok.
e|nggak enak hati.en: I feel bad that I can't come to your event tomorrow.
e|nggak enak hati.ko: 내일 네 행사에 못 가서 미안해.

e|nggak enak hati.text: Rasanya nggak enak hati sudah lama tidak menghubungi dia.
e|nggak enak hati.en: I feel bad that I haven't contacted him for a long time.
e|nggak enak hati.ko: 오랫동안 그를 연락하지 않아서 마음이 불편해.

e|nggak enak hati.text: Saya jadi nggak enak hati setelah tanpa sengaja memecahkan gelas di rumahmu.
e|nggak enak hati.en: I feel bad after accidentally breaking a glass at your house.
e|nggak enak hati.ko: 네 집에서 실수로 유리컵을 깨서 미안해.

e|nggak masuk akal.text: Harga kopi di warung itu benar-benar nggak masuk akal.
e|nggak masuk akal.en: The price of coffee at that stall is really unreasonable.
e|nggak masuk akal.ko: 그 가게의 커피 가격은 정말 말이 안 돼.

e|nggak masuk akal.text: Dia marah cuma karena hal kecil, menurutku itu nggak masuk akal.
e|nggak masuk akal.en: He got angry just because of a small thing, I think that's unreasonable.
e|nggak masuk akal.ko: 그가 작은 일로 화를 내는 건 내 생각에 말이 안 돼.

e|nggak masuk akal.text: Kenapa harus kerja selama dua puluh jam sehari? Itu nggak masuk akal.
e|nggak masuk akal.en: Why do we have to work for twenty hours a day? That doesn't make sense.
e|nggak masuk akal.ko: 왜 하루에 스무 시간씩 일해야 해? 그건 말이 안 돼.

e|nggak nyangka.text: Aku nggak nyangka kamu datang hari ini.
e|nggak nyangka.en: I didn't expect you to come today.
e|nggak nyangka.ko: 오늘 네가 올 줄은 정말 몰랐어.

e|nggak nyangka.text: Dia nggak nyangka bisa lulus ujian itu.
e|nggak nyangka.en: He didn't expect to pass that test.
e|nggak nyangka.ko: 그는 그 시험에 합격할 줄은 몰랐어.

e|nggak nyangka.text: Kita semua nggak nyangka hujan turun tiba-tiba.
e|nggak nyangka.en: None of us expected the rain to fall suddenly.
e|nggak nyangka.ko: 우리 모두 갑자기 비가 내릴 줄 몰랐어.

e|nggak pedas ya.text: Sambalnya nggak pedas ya, cocok untuk anak-anak.
e|nggak pedas ya.en: The chili sauce isn't spicy, right? It's suitable for kids.
e|nggak pedas ya.ko: 이 고추장은 맵지 않아서 아이들에게도 괜찮아요.

e|nggak pedas ya.text: Mau coba sup ini? Nggak pedas ya.
e|nggak pedas ya.en: Do you want to try this soup? It's not spicy, right?

e|nggak pedas ya.text: Ayam gorengnya nggak pedas ya, kamu pasti suka.
e|nggak pedas ya.en: The fried chicken isn't spicy, you'll definitely like it.
e|nggak pedas ya.ko: 이 프라이드치킨 맵지 않아서 분명히 좋아할 거예요.

e|oke deh.text: Oke deh, aku ikut nanti sore.
e|oke deh.en: Alright, I'll join later this afternoon.

e|oke deh.text: Oke deh, kita coba lagi besok.
Oke deh, terima kasih sudah membantu.

e|parah.en: Wow, the traffic jam is really bad today.
My test score is really bad.

e|parah.text: Cuacanya parah, hujan terus dari pagi.
e|parah.en: The weather is bad, it's been raining since morning.

e|permisi.en: Excuse me, I want to pass.
Excuse me, is this seat empty?
Excuse me, where is the toilet?

e|pokoknya.en: The main thing is you have to come tomorrow.
e|pokoknya.ko: 중요한 것은 네가 내일 꼭 와야 한다는 거야.

e|pokoknya.text: Pokoknya jangan lupa bawa payung, ya.
e|pokoknya.en: Just don't forget to bring an umbrella, okay.
e|pokoknya.ko: 중요한 건 우산 꼭 챙기는 거야.

e|pokoknya.text: Pokoknya aku nggak mau tahu, tugas harus selesai hari ini.
e|pokoknya.en: I don't care, the assignment must be finished today.
e|pokoknya.ko: 어쨌든 오늘 안에 과제가 끝나야 해.

e|salah fokus.text: Maaf, aku tadi salah fokus waktu kamu jelasin caranya.
e|salah fokus.en: Sorry, I got distracted when you explained how to do it.
e|salah fokus.ko: 미안해, 네가 방법을 설명할 때 내가 집중을 못 했어.

e|salah fokus.text: Tadi pas ujian aku sempat salah fokus gara-gara suara berisik.
e|salah fokus.en: Earlier during the test I got distracted because of the noisy sound.
e|salah fokus.ko: 아까 시험 볼 때 시끄러운 소리 때문에 잠깐 집중을 못 했어.

e|salah fokus.text: Aku sering salah fokus kalau kerja terlalu lama tanpa istirahat.
e|salah fokus.en: I often get distracted if I work too long without a break.
e|salah fokus.ko: 나는 휴식 없이 너무 오래 일하면 자주 집중을 못 해.

e|sama saja.text: Rasanya kopi ini sama saja dengan yang kemarin.
e|sama saja.en: This coffee tastes the same as yesterday's.
e|sama saja.ko: 이 커피는 어제 것과 맛이 똑같아.

e|sama saja.text: Harga di toko itu sama saja dengan di pasar.
e|sama saja.en: The price at that shop is the same as at the market.

e|sama saja.text: Kalau terlambat sedikit, hasilnya sama saja.
e|sama saja.en: If you are a little late, the result is the same.

e|sama-sama.en: Thanks for the coffee. You're welcome.

e|sampai jumpa.en: I am leaving now, see you!

e|santai aja.text: Santai aja, nanti juga semuanya akan beres kok.
e|santai aja.en: Just relax, everything will be fine later.
e|santai aja.ko: 그냥 편하게 있어, 나중에 다 괜찮아질 거야.

e|santai aja.text: Kalau kamu belum siap ngomong, santai aja dulu ya.
e|santai aja.en: If you're not ready to talk, just relax for now.
e|santai aja.ko: 아직 말할 준비가 안 됐으면, 그냥 편히 있어.

e|santai aja.text: Santai aja, nggak perlu buru-buru ngerjain tugasnya.
e|santai aja.en: Just relax, there's no need to rush doing the assignment.
e|santai aja.ko: 그냥 편하게 해, 과제 서두를 필요 없어.

e|saya paham maksudnya.en: Don't worry, I understand what you mean.

e|saya paham maksudnya.text: Maaf kalau saya terlambat, tapi saya paham maksudnya sekarang.
e|saya paham maksudnya.en: Sorry if I'm late, but I understand what you mean now.
e|saya paham maksudnya.ko: 늦어서 미안해요, 하지만 이제 무슨 뜻인지 알겠어요.

e|saya paham maksudnya.text: Setelah dijelaskan lagi, saya paham maksudnya.
e|saya paham maksudnya.en: After it was explained again, I understand what you mean.
e|saya paham maksudnya.ko: 다시 설명해 주셔서 이제 무슨 뜻인지 알겠어요.

e|saya sakit kepala.text: Maaf, saya tidak bisa ikut karena saya sakit kepala.
e|saya sakit kepala.en: Sorry, I can't join because I have a headache.
e|saya sakit kepala.ko: 미안해, 나는 두통이 있어서 같이 갈 수 없어.

e|saya sakit kepala.text: Tolong pelankan suara, saya sakit kepala.
e|saya sakit kepala.en: Please lower your voice, I have a headache.
e|saya sakit kepala.ko: 목소리를 좀 낮춰줘, 나는 두통이 있어.

e|saya sakit kepala.text: Hari ini saya sakit kepala, jadi ingin beristirahat.
e|saya sakit kepala.en: Today I have a headache, so I want to rest.
e|saya sakit kepala.ko: 오늘 나는 두통이 있어서 쉬고 싶어.

e|saya setuju.text: Kalau kamu mau pergi besok, saya setuju.
e|saya setuju.en: If you want to go tomorrow, I agree.
e|saya setuju.ko: 네가 내일 가고 싶다면, 나는 동의해.

e|saya setuju.en: I agree, this idea is good.

e|saya tidak mengerti.en: What do you mean? I don't understand.

e|saya tidak mengerti.ko: 다시 말해 주세요, 저는 이해하지 못해요.

e|saya tidak mengerti.text: Bisa bicara pelan-pelan? Saya tidak mengerti.
e|saya tidak mengerti.en: Can you speak slowly? I do not understand.
e|saya tidak mengerti.ko: 천천히 말해줄 수 있어요? 저는 이해하지 못해요.

e|saya tindak lanjuti.text: Terima kasih atas masukannya, saya tindak lanjuti segera.
e|saya tindak lanjuti.en: Thank you for your input, I will follow up on it right away.
e|saya tindak lanjuti.ko: 의견 주셔서 감사합니다, 바로 제가 처리하겠습니다.

e|saya tindak lanjuti.text: Kalau ada masalah lagi, saya tindak lanjuti seperti biasa.
e|saya tindak lanjuti.en: If there are more issues, I will follow up as usual.
e|saya tindak lanjuti.ko: 문제가 더 있으면 평소처럼 제가 처리할게요.

e|saya tindak lanjuti.text: Sudah saya catat, nanti saya tindak lanjuti dengan tim.
e|saya tindak lanjuti.en: I've noted it, I will follow up with the team later.

e|sayangnya.text: Sayangnya, saya tidak bisa datang hari ini.

e|sayangnya.en: Unfortunately, that store is already closed.
e|sayangnya.ko: 안타깝게도 그 가게는 이미 문을 닫았어요.

e|sayangnya.text: Sayangnya, hujan turun saat kita mau pergi.
e|sayangnya.en: Unfortunately, it rained when we were about to leave.
e|sayangnya.ko: 안타깝게도 우리가 나가려고 할 때 비가 왔어요.

e|sebenarnya.text: Dia sebenarnya sudah pulang dari tadi.
e|sebenarnya.ko: 사실 그는 아까 이미 집에 갔어.

e|sebenarnya.text: Sebenarnya kamu mau pergi ke mana?
e|sebenarnya.en: Where do you actually want to go?
